method: Grades marked "Script:" were recomputed by tools/grade.py from the packages as they are now (contrast, token provenance, the README's Do and don't list, and DESIGN.md freshness). Criteria optional for a capture (see each criterion) count only where the product publishes them and are otherwise graded not applicable. Every other grade comes from the review that last set it (each package's reviewed date, else the 2026-10-16 review): public-web capture review. On 2026-11-20 the reviews of classpass, clay-earth, clearful, dji, forhers, huddlekit and intercom, which their captures wrote to review files but never merged, were merged unchanged from those files; so were the later reviews of chargetrip (after its mismeasured-surface fix) and kitchen (its signed-in recapture), whose snapshots were overwritten by same-named sibling snapshots. ikea's review was rebuilt from the Health section of commit 109098807; its six meets grades (F3, F5, F7, F8, F9, K1) have no surviving evidence text.
